about_the_game:
This is a first-person touch simulation game.

You can start interacting quickly — no story, no dialogue.

The demo does not include any sexual positions.
It features outfit display animations and lets you experience the character’s reactions through touch.
It also has a fully-featured auto mode, making it easy to play with one hand.

Game Features

  • Immersive Touch Experience: A first-person touch simulation where the character reacts differently based on touch speed.

  • Color Customization System: Freely adjust clothing colors to create your favorite look.

  • Simple and Intuitive Controls: Designed for comfortable one-handed play.

  • Auto-play feature: Right-click to activate auto mode and enjoy effortlessly.

This game contains adult content. All interactions are fully consensual and romantic in nature. This game does not include non-consensual acts, BDSM, NTR, extreme violence, drug/alcohol abuse, or any other potentially disturbing content.
